title: Acceleration AI Ethics, the Debate between Innovation and Safety, and Stability AI’s Diffusion versus OpenAI’s Dall-E

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating centralized versus decentralized approaches to representational fairness by analyzing how text-to-image models allocate gender to non-gendered or ambiguously gendered nouns (e.g., 'Sumo wrestler', 'waitress') through either centrally injected algorithmic randomness or decentralized reinforcement learning with human feedback.
